correctness.rationale: For occupied S, diagonal generator sum |S|+c sum vacant infected-neighbor incidences and offdiagonal recoveries or colonizations yield a unique finite hitting-time linear system. The two six-vertex cubic graphs are exactly complements of C6 and 2C3, respectively. Their 63 nonempty states reduce to 9 and 12 automorphism orbits. Independently constructed quotient matrices and inverted over Q(c), reproducing all six submitted c^3 P_k/(s_k A B) identities, including P_4=P_5=P_6 and every strictly positive coefficient; at c=0 both are pure death chains with mean H_k. Additional unrelated full 63-state rational systems at c=1/3 and 1 agreed and gave all 12 strict inequalities. Thus positivity is an analytic all-c certificate, not grid extrapolation.
